name: io.github.dpremirelli/dietfit
title: DietFit
description: Checks if a food fits a gluten-free diet, using sourced rules and dietitian review. Prototype.

tools.name: check_diet_fit
tools.description: Returns fits, does_not_fit or uncertain for one food product and one diet, with the rules that decided it and their sources. Give either a barcode (looked up in Open Food Facts) or the product's ingredient list and label claims. Uncertain results are queued for review by a registered dietitian; treat uncertain as not safe until reviewed. Supports diet 'gluten-free' with mode 'celiac' (strict, default) or 'gluten_avoidance'. PROTOTYPE FOR TESTING: not for use with real people.

mode.description: celiac = strict; gluten_avoidance = ignores 'may contain' warnings.

barcode.description: Product barcode (UPC or EAN). Used if no ingredient list is given.

ingredients_text.description: Full ingredient list as printed on the package, in English.

label_claims.description: Claims printed on the package, e.g. 'Gluten-free'.

allergen_statement.description: The package's 'Contains' or 'May contain' statement, if any.

tools.name: get_diet_rules
tools.description: Returns the full, versioned rule set used by check_diet_fit, with every rule's source and the decisions log.
